focused_integration_cases.detail: The actual emitted migration reverses all seven former helper contributions once for completed pre-wrapper roots. Repeated migration is inert. Early initialization sends proposals and grants no programme spirits, assets, research or treasury transfers.
Completed guarded-save roots with paid receipts receive the same exact one-time inverses. Proposal authorization does not itself grant rewards or charge new setup fees.
Completed old pending wrappers without paid receipts receive no inverse modifier contributions. Their obsolete pending flags are cleared.
New early root completions carrying their new authorization receipts do not receive phantom inverse legacy contributions.

The three actual root completion rewards contain only their new authoritative helper. Advanced Israel requires F7, advanced Canada and Mexico require E9. Public availability exposes both actual parent spirits; ready guards cover offers, final acceptance, reconciliation and recurring streams.

Each income/expense bucket invokes and consumes each early/advanced pure stream exactly once. Fixed signed programme expenses are appended after the native inflation multiplier. The alliance-only expense variable is not consumed as a second charge.

Executed the custom callback extracted from the actual NATO_member on_add provider with later Spanish membership. It sends exactly one proposal. Repeated callback does not send a duplicate event. Recipient consent activates the paired programme and exact 0.005 weekly USA expense.

Executed the custom callback extracted from the actual Major_Non_NATO_Ally on_add provider with an alternate Soviet RP membership. It sends exactly one proposal. Repeated callback is inert while pending. Recipient consent activates the paired programme and exact 0.005 weekly USA expense.
